task.description:
Implement IN-UI-05 through IN-UI-08 frontend requirements for the instance detail page. All designs are in src/design/in-ui-05-event-history.md through in-ui-08-auto-refresh.md.

Context: You are working on branch feature/WF02-f3b-inui0508-20260530 (already set up in Step 00).

Existing code to build on:
- web/src/pages/instances/InstanceDetailPage.tsx — has basic tabs, event log, timeline feed, cancel button
- web/src/hooks/useInstances.ts — has useInstanceEvents, useInstanceTimeline, useCancelInstance
- web/src/api/instances.ts — has API calls
- web/src/types/api.ts — has types

Requirements to implement:
1. IN-UI-05 MUST: Event history tab — add filter bar (event_type select, time range inputs), make JSON payload expandable inline
2. IN-UI-06 MUST: Timeline tab — add actor avatars (deterministic color from name), human-readable descriptions, improve vertical feed styling
3. IN-UI-07 MUST: Cancel instance — add confirmation dialog with optional reason, role-gate button (PROCESS_OPERATOR+), ensure optimistic update with rollback works
4. IN-UI-08 SHOULD: Auto-refresh — create usePolling hook, add RefreshIndicator component, integrate into InstanceBoardPage and InstanceDetailPage

After implementation:
- Run npm run type-check (must exit 0)
- Run npm run lint (must exit 0)
- Run npm run build (must exit 0)
- Commit and push to feature branch
acceptance_criteria: IN-UI-05: History tab has event type filter and time range filter
IN-UI-05: Raw JSON payload is expandable inline
IN-UI-06: Timeline has actor avatars with deterministic colors
IN-UI-07: Cancel button shows confirmation dialog
IN-UI-07: Cancel button is role-gated (hidden for non-operators)
IN-UI-07: Optimistic update with rollback on error
IN-UI-08: Auto-refresh polls every 10s with configurable interval
IN-UI-08: Shows last-refreshed indicator and manual refresh button
Implementation committed and pushed to feature branch

result.summary: Implemented IN-UI-05..08 on instance pages: event history filters with expandable payload JSON, timeline feed with deterministic actor avatars and improved item rendering, role-gated cancel confirmation dialog with optimistic rollback UX, and shared polling refresh indicators on board/detail pages.
